setting: Mio's house on Friday evening; each person stays in the room appropriate to the action; casual indoor clothes

sentences.english: On Friday evening, I have just finished my long homework.
sentences.japanese: 金曜日の夜、長かった宿題をちょうど終えたところ。

sentences.english: I put down my pencil and took a deep breath.
sentences.japanese: わたしはえんぴつを置いて、深く息を吐きました。

sentences.english: “Have you already finished all your homework?” I asked my sister.
sentences.japanese: わたしは妹にも、もう宿題を終えたのかと聞きました。

sentences.english: “Yes, I have already finished it before dinner,” she answered with a smile.
sentences.japanese: 妹は「うん、夕食の前にもう終わらせたよ」と笑顔で答えました。

sentences.english: But my brother was still reading a book.
sentences.japanese: でも、兄はまだ本を読んでいました。

sentences.english: “Have you read that English book yet?” I asked.
sentences.japanese: 「その英語の本はもう読んだ？」とわたしは聞きました。

sentences.english: “No, I have not read it yet,” he answered.
sentences.japanese: 「いや、まだ読んでいないよ」と兄は答えました。

sentences.english: From the kitchen, my mother called, “Is dinner ready?”
sentences.japanese: 台所から母が「夕ご飯できた?」と声をかけてきました。

sentences.english: “Yes, I have just finished making it,” she answered.
sentences.japanese: 「うん、ちょうど今作り終わったよ」と母自身が答えました。

sentences.english: My father came home early and was watering plants in the garden.
sentences.japanese: 父は早く帰ってきて、庭で植物に水をあげていました。

sentences.english: “I have already finished all my work for today,” he said.
sentences.japanese: 「今日の仕事はもう全部終わったよ」と言いました。
